name: com.engincandanabas.savetoolkit
description: ScriptableObject-configured save system for mobile and Steam games: per-platform/store profiles, JSON or MessagePack, GZip, AES-256 + HMAC, rotating backups with corruption recovery, data migrations, save slots, async saves and autosave. Low-allocation pipeline built on pooled buffers.

samples.description: SaveController prefab, a PlayerProgress demo (sync + async) and a SaveableBehaviour example.
